sound_replay.method:
Compare tick-indexed arcade sound state and VIC registers on a live replay.

Host PC observations only: no guest code, registers, clocks or sound are patched.
CPU timestamps can differ; this checks the values produced at each logical tick.

limitations: One saved NTSC route; no fixed-rate deadline guarantee or physical-hardware test.
Average throughput gain is small; native p95/max refresh and maximum input/audio gaps worsen.
Several partial-pose counts and actual p95 redraw interval grow; no claim of perceptible flicker/smoothness improvement.
Smoke forces intermission levels; not an unaided full playthrough.
Tick-indexed sound registers match; exact write times and PCM audio not compared.
Captured stack writes are observations, not maximum bounds.
